# Travel China Guide

> > Comprehensive China travel planning resource offering guided tours, transportation booking, and destination guides for Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Guilin, and other major Chinese cities.

Travel China Guide is a full-service China travel agency providing private tours, small group tours, train ticket booking, and detailed city guides covering attractions, transportation, history, and practical travel tips for destinations throughout China including the Terracotta Army, water towns, and cultural landmarks.

## Key Topics

- Beijing
- Shanghai
- Xi'an
- Guilin
- Chengdu
- Terracotta Army
- China tours and packages
- Private and small group tours
- China train tickets and booking
- City guides and attractions
- Airport transportation
- Water towns (Suzhou, Hangzhou)
- Tour planning and itineraries
- Chinese history and culture
- Family travel activities

## Tour Services & Booking

- [China Travel Agency, Small Group & Private Tour Service](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/): Homepage for China travel agency offering tours to Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an
- [China Trains Tickets, Best Rail Booking Service, Realtime Schedule](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/china-trains/): China train ticket booking service with real-time schedules & e-tickets

## Major City Guides

- [Shanghai Travel China: Facts, Attractions, City Map, Weather, Tips](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/cityguides/shanghai.htm): Comprehensive Shanghai city guide covering Bund, Nanjing Road & attractions

## Transportation & Airport Maps

- [Shanghai Pudong Airport Maps: Terminal 1, 2 & PVG Terminal Shuttle](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/cityguides/shanghai/pudong-airport-maps.htm): Pudong Airport terminal maps showing T1, T2 layouts & shuttle routes
- [Xi'an Metro Maps, PDF Download & Printable: Lines, Subway Stations](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/cityguides/xian/transportation/metro-subway-map.htm): Xi'an metro system maps with all lines, stations & airport connections

## Chinese History & Culture

- [Ming Dynasty in China History: Economy, Culture, Science](https://www.travelchinaguide.com/intro/history/ming.htm): Ming Dynasty history guide covering Zhu Yuanzhang & imperial China era
